client.name: <Client Name>
client.niche: <e.g. local window installer | pet-treats ecommerce | kratom/botanicals ecommerce (YMYL)>
client.primary_market: <geo the site actually serves, or 'national / online'>
client.stated_goal: <the owner's real goal in their words : e.g. 'more qualified leads', '30%/yr organic growth'>
client._comment: niche + primary_market steer recovery weighting (YMYL -> E-E-A-T first; local-service -> GBP+location; ecom -> collection/intent architecture). Fill what you know; leave blanks rather than guessing.

period.label: <e.g. Feb - Jul 2026 . 6-Month Foundation Review>
period._comment: start/end = engagement window under review. baseline_* OPTIONAL: set only if a genuine 'before' exists (needed to tell a core-update DEMOTION from a never-graduated SANDBOX). Partial final months are auto-flagged + excluded from trend charts.

gsc.account: <account alias from list_accounts, if >1 account connected>
gsc._comment: GSC is pulled LIVE via mcp__google-search-console__* . The .env GSC_REFRESH_TOKEN is EMPTY here, so there is NO direct-OAuth path -- use the MCP. If export_dir is set, exports there are read first and the MCP fills gaps. brand_regex classifies brand vs non-brand queries -- the single most important sandbox signal; include the brand name AND its common misspellings.

inputs._comment: All optional. page_inventory/sitemap -> what is actually live+indexed. task_log/work_plan -> what the agency shipped (report credits done work, finds the gap). backlinks_export -> Ahrefs/Semrush CSV OR leave blank to pull via DataForSEO backlinks MCP (AHREFS_API_KEY / SEMRUSH_API_KEY in .env are EMPTY -- no direct Ahrefs/Semrush call). competitors -> domains for the authority-gap math.

live_site_access._comment: mode: 'url' (fetch live -- preferred; browser UA + cache-bust), 'saved_html' (local snapshots), or 'none' (skip live verification). Cloudflare/anti-bot sites may need the SCRAPINGBEE_KEY fetch path -- see references/data-sources-and-tools.md.

enhancements._comment: Real external data tools. dataforseo -> DataForSEO MCP (backlinks, historical rank, live SERP, Lighthouse, content dedup). clarity -> Microsoft Clarity MCP (behavior; only if that client's project is connected). valueserp -> VALUESERP_API_KEY live SERP (SET). pagespeed -> PAGESPEED_API_KEY mobile CWV (SET). Set false to skip even when available.

custom_inputs._comment: Free-form bag for anything specific to THIS client that doesn't fit above -- a CallRail leads export, an EAV/entity sheet, a KG doc, a schema file, a migration changelog, a homepage-rebuild handoff. Add keys as needed, reference them in the relevant phase; do NOT rename a standard field to fit.
